headline: Five o'clock unseals the river.
body: A bakery vent writes steam across a brick wall that has not yet decided to be warm. Somewhere a shutter chain complains once and then thinks better of it. The hour keeps its coat on.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: thin pewter, Venus still arguing with the east

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: shopfront neon left on, pink against wet pavement

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: the hush before kettles, not quite loneliness
